correctness.rationale: Faithful relation/box correspondence; distance characterization of all alternating products on the bipartite graph of class intersections; monotonic strict growth until the equivalence join; cross-chain intersection only at the join; explicit parity obstruction and attaining paths for the sharp N-world maximum. Finite checks are corroboration only, with no inference of infinite completeness from enumeration.

value.rationale: Exact complete classification of a natural invariant of finite two-agent epistemic models, not just a routine count: it computes stabilization length of alternating nested knowledge from observable class-incidence graph geometry; proves no different starts agree prematurely; yields a tight all-world extremal bound with an even/odd gap and explicit attaining path frames. There is a direct interpretive use for reducing modal nesting on finite correlated S5 models. No claims about all modal formulas or downstream algorithmic complexity are made.
